ache.title: Baby Nero’s first guide. I’m watching it
ache.note: One of Nero’s very first character guides, all about Jinwu. A guide teaches you to play a character well, which is fine, but it also quietly sells her: watch long enough and ‘how to play Jinwu’ becomes ‘I need Jinwu’. Enjoy the nostalgia. Don’t let it pick your next pull.
watch: a guide that doubles as an ad
ache.tip: Watch guides for characters you already own. Treat the rest as curiosity, not a shopping list.
lines: look how tiny his channel was
a guide is not a reason to pull
Jinwu is cool. your savings are cooler
